region_name: Punjab Flood Plains (Indus & Chenab River Basin), Pakistan

sample_measurements.region_name: Punjab Indus–Chenab Basin, Pakistan (Confirmed Flood Inundation Core)
sample_measurements.sign_convention: Negative (-dB) indicates decreased radar backscatter (consistent with water specular reflection or drying); Positive (+dB) indicates increased radar backscatter (roughness or moisture).
limitations: Radar backscatter change (dB) detects surface roughness and dielectric property changes; it is NOT ground elevation change.
Smooth water bodies reflect radar pulses away specularly; wind-roughened open water or flooded vegetation can produce complex backscatter variations.
Radar shadow and layover zones are masked and never interpolated.
